summary_md: **DailyPapers ([@HuggingPapers](https://x.com/HuggingPapers/status/2115718764507615252))** shares **OmniShowcase**, which generates consistent 360° videos of a subject from four photos by conditioning a video model on reconstructed surface-normal turntables, halving geometric error versus the best multi-view baseline; the follow-up links the [paper](https://paperswithcode.co/paper/2610.35684), [project page](https://justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase/) and [code](https://github.com/justin4ai/OmniShowcase).
